query: INSERT INTO account_signing_providers (account_id, provider_id, enabled, required_qualifiers, refuse_name_mismatch, session_minutes, client_secret_sealed, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $8, $9) ON CONFLICT (account_id, provider_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = $3, required_qualifiers = $4, refuse_name_mismatch = $5, session_minutes = $6, client_secret_sealed = CASE WHEN $7 THEN $8 ELSE account_signing_providers.client_secret_sealed END, updated_at = $9
